memberships.page_title: A Cubic-Jet Rank Obstruction to Further Homogeneous Descent

statement: The equivariant cubic rank-six compression condition has a 20-dimensional affine slice, and the quartic obstruction functional is identically one on that slice; modulo two target-row directions this is the natural transverse compression space.
